reset_confirm_message:
Are you sure you want to reset all game progress?
This action cannot be undone.
map_sealed_continue: Clear more levels to explore further
map_sealed_chapter: Finish {chapter} to unlock the next chapter
hint_rotate_first: Tap a piece to select it, press Rotate to turn it, then drag it onto the outline
hint_linked_rotation: A piece with a solid dot turns the pieces with a ring along with it; turning a ringed piece moves only itself
tutorial_time_body: The bar at the top counts down once you start moving. Finish before the stars drop off to keep all 3.
tutorial_drag_title: Drag the piece to the glowing spot
tutorial_drag_body: Drop it near the highlighted place and it snaps onto the grid.
tutorial_second_body: Drag the second piece so its tip touches the first one.
tutorial_select_title: Tap the roof piece to select it
tutorial_select_body: The selected piece lights up and the Rotate button becomes active.
tutorial_rotate_title: Press Rotate until the roof points up
tutorial_rotate_body: Each press turns the piece one step. Keep turning until the roof tip points up.
tutorial_turned_drag_title: Drag the turned piece onto the outline
tutorial_turned_drag_body: Drop it near the outline and it snaps onto the grid.
tutorial_final_body: The last piece sits right below the roof.
tutorial_tip_hold: Second tap: keep your finger down
tutorial_button_body: Press Rotate in the bottom corner to turn the roof piece one step.
tutorial_double_body: Tap the roof piece twice in a row, quickly: it turns one step too.
tutorial_hold_title: Double-tap and hold to keep turning
tutorial_hold_body: Double-tap, but keep your finger down on the second tap: the piece turns step by step. You can drag while holding.
